title: Devanity repository rules
description: One declaration per repository, compiled into three surfaces: the context the kernel receives per path, the PreToolUse/Stop guards, and the reference CI job. Absent file: every path is `normal`, guards record and never block.

paths.description: Glob (relative to the repository root; `**` crosses directories) → rule. The most specific matching glob wins; ties go to the last declared.

check.description: Command the Stop oracle and the CI job run for a change under this path.

purpose.description: One line: what this path is. Injected into every session with the path's invariants (the repository map).

id.description: The principle's id (e.g. P-012), unique across the map: one id, one rule.

kind.description: What kind of rule: product, design, trade, acceptance, scope, …

from.description: The decision ids this principle was induced from (the ledger's G-/D-/T-/I- ids).

check.description: The command that fails when the principle is broken, when one exists.

declared.description: true for a principle a human wrote directly, with no decision behind it.

invariants.description: What never changes under this path. A string, or a principle object (A2.1): a rule with an id and a provenance (`from` decisions, or `declared: true`), so the next decision on the same axis is derived instead of asked. Owners come from CODEOWNERS, never from here.

core.description: The stable center the product's pivots must survive, orthogonal to tier: its invariants are rigid, its content is not. A change that alters one is rung 5.

tests.description: Globs naming test files (overlaid on HEAD by the Stop oracle). Default: test_*, *_test.*, *.test.*, *.spec.*, tests/**.

commands.description: Bash command patterns (regular expressions) that need at least the named authority; checked by the PreToolUse guard on top of the built-in list.

autonomy.description: Envelope for unattended sessions. `merge` and `deploy` are never grantable here.

verifiers.description: Globs of the files the declared checks read (package scripts, test-runner config, root conftest). The reference CI job treats a diff that edits one together with code as a verifier change.
